question: Buccal cavity is a part of the human ________ system.
solution:
The correct answer is__** digestive.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Buccal cavity **is a part of the **human digestive system**.
 
• It is also known as the** oral cavity or mouth**.
 
• It is the first part of the **digestive system** where food enters the body and is broken down by the teeth and **saliva **before being swallowed.
 
• The buccal cavity also plays a role in **speech and taste **perception.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Circulatory system** is responsible for the** circulation of blood and nutrients **throughout the body.

 
 
• It includes the **heart, blood vessels, and blood.**
 
 
 
• **Respiratory system** is responsible for the **exchange of gases** (oxygen and carbon dioxide) between the body and the environment.
 
 
• It includes the **lungs, trachea, and bronchi.**
 
 
 
• **Excretory system** is responsible for the **elimination of waste products** from the body.
 
 
• It includes the **kidneys, bladder, and urethra.**
